blocks.content: In this course, you'll learn SQL step-by-step, building a strong foundation through hands-on practice. Here's how the learning process works:
By the end of this course, you'll think like a data analyst and confidently use SQL to solve real-world problems.
Now, let's start with the foundation of SQL queries—the SELECT statement. Click the Next Lesson button to learn about the SELECT statement.
